Frame and Today against the reference pictures

Each of the design's 19 reference pictures (docs/specs/Chausar-App-Design.html) beside the fake-engine preview's drawing of the same screen at 1366 x 768, in the same theme, view and language. Generated by frontend-validation/visual/page.mjs on 2026-10-14; pictures are downscaled JPEG. The preview draws synthetic data from the fake engine, so names and amounts differ from the pictures by design; the notes list the layout differences. Status: frame-today is this lane's screen; other lane is drawn by another lane's place module; not built yet shows the design's not-built state; not drawable has no desktop-preview counterpart.

S01-Today frame-today

Today, the screen the app opens on / Today

Design entries
design-1-the-design-in-one-minute TD-01
Owner
frame-today
Address
index.html?scenario=populated&lang=en&view=guided&theme=…#/today/today

Differences

  • Content is synthetic: the fake engine's scoped Today producer offers three prepared requests and two worth-a-look rows, not the picture's reminders, payment and Freight Outward question; its review count is not known, so the title carries no number and the partial-scope note (not sure) sits under the title.
  • The populated demo workspace shows two banners (Demo clock, Jobs paused) above the page; the picture has none. They push This month and Earlier today below the fold at 768 high.
  • Each figure tile adds the producer's "Definition, coverage" link and the figures section ends with the Prepare figures button (with its note only until figures are prepared); the picture has neither.
  • The ask line carries the no-model note under it, and the status line's three facts are longer than the picture's, so the third wraps onto a second line.
  • Rail: Today has no count beside it (the scoped producer does not know the whole-app count).

Fixed in this round

  • The host's full-width "Read again" bar above the frame is gone once a workspace is open (Read again moved into the workspace menu); the rail and page start at the top of the window as in the picture.
  • The scoped controls no longer stack as separate full-width blocks between the title and the rows: Open review list sits at the right of the title, and Prepare figures sits under the figures (its note beside it only until figures are prepared).
  • The date, title and review rows read as one block (no 32 px grid gap between each), so the rows start right under the title.
  • "See all" in Worth a look sits at the start, as wide as its words, instead of centred across the column.
  • Status facts that wrap sit 4 px apart instead of 24 px.
  • The three figure tiles keep their labels, figures and charts on common lines: tiles of different heights no longer spread their rows apart.
